Arrive Furongzhen.notes: Arrive ~11:30; ~6 km to the old town.

Check in at Waterfall Bay.notes: Check in and drop bags. Buy the ¥108 ticket (valid 2–3 days).

Liu Xiaoqing rice tofu.notes: Historic rice-tofu snack stop associated with actress Liu Xiaoqing.

Wuli Stone Street.notes: The 2.5 km flagstone spine of a 2,000-year-old river trading port.

Tuwang Palace.notes: Seat of the Tujia Tusi (chieftain) rulers.

Xizhou Bronze Pillar.notes: The 940 AD peace-treaty column — the key relic of Tujia history.

Furong waterfall.notes: Plank walkway behind the 60 m waterfall curtain (expect spray).

Youshui River cruise.notes: Best full panorama of Furong’s waterfall, stacked town and reflections.

Dinner.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Far-bank platform.notes: The classic postcard angle across the Youshui.

Shenpu Camp Square.notes: Wide panorama of lights + waterfall on the night viewpoint circuit.

Baishetang Square.notes: Free Tujia song-and-dance with the waterfall as backdrop (included in ticket).

Dawn photo session.notes: Out before breakfast — morning mist on the Youshui, empty streets, soft light.

Breakfast.notes: Hotel breakfast; open the hotel card for details.

Old-town mop-up.notes: Anything skipped — behind-the-falls walkway in morning light, Tuwang Palace.

Lunch.notes: Venue not chosen yet — open for shortlisted options.

Head to the station.notes: Leave with a buffer for the ~08:30 train (station ~10 km / 20 min out).
